supporting_article_titles: Retrofitting Machines to Improve Manufacturing Quality
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Legacy production equipment can be retrofitted with sensing/inspection capability instead of replaced, creating a repeatable readiness, acceptance and evidence workflow around quality retrofits.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: legacy-machine quality retrofit planning and acceptance
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Select retrofit candidates, define acceptance metrics, track installation evidence and prove quality improvement before production release.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Retrofit decisions, baseline defects, acceptance tests and sign-offs are split across spreadsheets, maintenance notes and supplier documents.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Machine register + retrofit readiness score + baseline/target quality metrics + action/evidence ledger + acceptance gate.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: Legacy machine quality retrofits için readiness ve acceptance evidence workspace.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Manufacturing quality coverage is increasingly being extended by retrofitting existing machines rather than full replacement.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Legacy equipment is common across mature manufacturing corridors; Trakya applicability should be evidenced during validation.
evidence_notes.validation_requirement: Resolve/read original article and research direct competitors.

raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: AI tıbbi cihazlar için sürekli post-market monitoring ve regulator evidence workspace.
raw_opportunities.why_now: UK authorities signaled continual monitoring of AI-based medical devices.

evidence_notes.validation_requirement: Verify primary UK regulator source and direct competitors.

supporting_article_titles: South Korea's Lee says AI appears to have been used in bank hacks

raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI-assisted cyber incident evidence and remediation assurance
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Capture suspected AI-enabled attack techniques, affected controls, remediation owners and proof of closure for risk/audit review.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: SOC evidence, control gaps, remediation tickets and audit narratives are fragmented.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Incident/tactic register + control mapping + evidence links + remediation owner/deadline + closure attestation + audit pack.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: Bankalar için AI-assisted cyber incident control-gap ve remediation evidence workspace.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Reuters reported South Korea's president saying AI appeared to have been used in bank hacks.
